contract: docs/DESIGN.md — HRMS ops tool, 'Calm Depth' direction, light/dark/system themes, brand-token theming, targets 390x844 and 1440x900

accessibility.evidence: Visible brand focus ring on the focused employee search input (desktop-employees-empty.jpg). Theme switch is a labelled radiogroup (Light/Dark/System found by accessible name). Modal/palette use role=dialog with labels; Escape closes the palette (exercised). Text stays legible on light and dark surfaces in the captured screens. Not measured: numeric contrast ratios; prefers-reduced-motion is implemented (CSS media query + MotionConfig reducedMotion=user) but was not emulated in the browser.

responsive.evidence: At 390x844 the dashboard has no horizontal overflow (scrollWidth 390 = clientWidth 390), header collapses to menu+search+theme toggle, and the navigation drawer slides in over a blurred backdrop (mobile-dashboard-dark.jpg, mobile-drawer-dark.jpg). At 1440x900 the sidebar, KPI row, charts and tables lay out without overlap; employee filters stay on one row after the width fix (desktop-employees-light.jpg).

loading.evidence: Auth-check spinner shown while the session loads on mobile (mobile-loading.jpg); dashboard and tables use skeleton placeholders with the same layout.

empty.evidence: Employee search with no matches shows an inbox icon, 'No records found' and '0 record(s)' (desktop-employees-empty.jpg).

error.evidence: Wrong password on login shows the API's 'Invalid email or password' message inline with a shake animation; form stays editable (desktop-login-error.png).

partial.evidence: Employees table shows one page of 20 with '485 records · page 1 of 25' and Prev/Next controls (desktop-employees-paged.jpg).

success.evidence: Valid login navigates to the dashboard with the greeting and live KPIs (desktop-dashboard-light.jpg). Toast success styling was redesigned but not re-captured in this pass.

permission.evidence: Verified at the API earlier in this session: an employee login gets 403 on HR endpoints and 404 on draft payslips; the layout redirects non-HR users to /me. The employee-role UI was not re-rendered in this design pass.

renderedEvidence.observation: Split login: dark 3D product scene (attendance ring, payslip, biometric scan, notification cards in perspective) and light sign-in form with theme switch.
Inline error state on failed sign-in.
Light dashboard: greeting, quick actions, 3D KPI tiles, attendance area chart, today ring.
Dark dashboard after toggling theme: remapped neutrals and status colours, brand-tinted active nav, smoothed trend without weekly-off dips.
Employees table with filters on one row and staggered row entrance.
Partial/paged table footer with record count and pagination.
Empty state and visible focus ring.
Ctrl+K palette searching employees live ('priya' → 5 matches).
Phone layout of the dark dashboard without horizontal scroll.
Loading state while the session is checked.
